# IF-alignment robustness and scalability audits

Created: 2026-05-22T04:07:56.154249+00:00

Runtime is measured from cached audit feature frames and does not include original RDKit/receptor feature extraction. Geometry noise is applied to cached distance-summary features at test time, so it is a geometry-feature robustness proxy rather than a full coordinate recomputation.
